author: Kavita S.
text: A South Mumbai staple for our family! Warden & Sons has the best pure cotton jhablas, onesies, and daily playwear. Friendly owners and great quality that survives Mumbai humidity.

author: Rohit Mehta
text: Conveniently located right at Kemps Corner near St. Stephen's Church. Much quicker and more personalized than wandering large malls. Helpful measuring and honest size recommendations.

author: Dr. Ananya P.
text: Been shopping here since my first child was born. The breathable cotton fabrics, school uniforms, and nightwear are top quality. Wonderful family-run shop in Kemps Corner.
